title: Game dev, Godot, Blender, graphics and animation educators and news
description: Official engine news, game-industry news and educators' channels and blogs for Godot, Blender, graphics, pixel art and animation. YouTube items use the channel Atom feed with a channel ID confirmed in search results.

items.title: Godot Engine blog RSS
items.summary: Official Godot news: releases, dev snapshots, foundation news and showcase posts. The site also publishes /rss.json and /atom.xml.
items.licence: Godot website content: see godotengine.org; engine is MIT
items.notes: The permalinks /rss.xml, /rss.json and /atom.xml are defined in the godotengine/godot-website source (pages/ directory, fetched 2026-10-10); a Godot forum answer also points to /rss.xml. godotengine.org itself could not be fetched.

items.title: Blender.org news feed

items.licence: Blender Foundation site terms
